_comment: A Bo3 as the MatchZy plugin reports it: series_start, then for each map going_live,
round_end (per-player stats cumulative within the map), halftime_started and side_swap,
player_stats_update and map_result, then series_end. Payload shapes follow
api/src/integrations/cs2/events/matchzy-events.types.ts and what the plugin sends (nested team blocks,
winner { side: '3' | '2', team }). matchid is the placeholder {{matchid}}: the replay spec
substitutes the numeric matches row id, as MatchZy sends it. Teams, players and the veto
result (de_ancient, de_anubis, de_nuke) are fixed and created by the spec.
Only a sample of round_end events is kept (rounds 1, 6, 12 and the last of each map):
MAT keeps the last cumulative snapshot per map, so the rounds in between add nothing.
